briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate AGI capability race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with o4 and Gemini 3 pushing reasoning benchmarks. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally. Multi-agent security gaps widen as deployment accelerates.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced agentic capabilities; Anthropic's Claude 4.5 follows next week. DeepSeek-V4 and xAI Grok-3 beta show strong performance. Google's Gemini 3 leads in multimodal long-context tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits supply constraints; Microsoft and CoreWeave announce 50k H100 cluster expansions. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q3 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU slow frontier model releases before 2027?
